about_the_game:
"Your sister's first driving lesson! If you fail to teach her properly as an older brother, your survival cannot be guaranteed. Will you be able to survive safely until the end?"

Your younger sister, who just got her driver’s license, is heading out onto the road for the very first time.
From starting the engine to steering the wheel, from stepping on the accelerator to braking—everything feels clumsy and awkward.
You can’t drive yourself since you’re in the passenger seat, but you can help guide her with your words.

Give her the right advice at the right time so she doesn’t go off course, and point out her mistakes.
From simple S-curves to parking, road driving, and unexpected emergencies—anything can happen!
Will you survive until your sister’s driving lessons are finally over?

Game Features

  • Passenger-seat perspective – A unique experience from the seat beside the driver

  • Voice-based control – Give instructions and advice instead of driving yourself

  • Variety of courses & difficulties – From beginner lessons to real road driving

  • Reactions & events – Her nerves, mistakes, and hilarious mishaps

  • Fun yet challenging goal – Complete the lessons safely and survive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone required. 4GB+ VRAM required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone required. 4GB+ VRAM required.
